name: web_spatial_snapshot
description:
web_spatial_snapshot:

Create a compact “2D page map” of what matters:
- interactive anchors (buttons/links/inputs) with rendered bounding boxes (x,y,w,h)
- small snippets of visible text located near each anchor (proximity filter)

Use this to understand large JS-heavy pages without huge DOM snapshots.
It usually reduces page text/noise by ~90% and preserves “this label is next to that button” relationships.

outputs.description: Unique id for this spatial snapshot result.

arguments_prompt:
Fill arguments for `web_spatial_snapshot`:

- question (optional): short bias prompt, e.g. "close the cookie modal", "find Add to Cart".
- radius_px (optional): pixel radius for nearby text; default 160.
- max_anchors (optional): cap interactive anchors returned; default 60.
- per_anchor_nearby (optional): nearby text snippets per anchor; default 4.

Return JSON like:
{
  "tool_name": "web_spatial_snapshot",
  "arguments": {
    "question": "Find the Add to Cart button for the cheeseburger item",
    "radius_px": 160,
    "max_anchors": 60,
    "per_anchor_nearby": 4,
    "max_text_candidates": 900
  }
}
